verdict.rationale: Maritime documents cron triggers that take standard five-field expressions, wake the agent on schedule, and deliver a prompt on every fire. Agents can also set recurring schedules in natural language, which the platform syncs into real wake triggers, and the docs position Maritime as a home for migrated cron jobs and scheduled functions. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of programmatic trigger management (CLI/API/SDK) and of run history or failure handling for scheduled fires.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A cron trigger takes a standard five-field expression, wakes the agent on schedule, and delivers its `prompt` as a chat message on every fire.
the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers
Move the automation layer of your cloud onto Maritime agents: cron jobs, scheduled functions, background workers, and bots.
